protocolAudiences.name: D2_INTERNAL_AUDIENCE
protocolAudiences.description: The single universal internal receive audience. The entry service mints exactly one internal transaction-token with aud=this value, and every hop validates aud == this value. It is NOT a token-exchange target. As the universal receive audience, it makes forward-unchanged possible.

protocolAudiences.name: D2_EDGE_SELF_AUDIENCE
protocolAudiences.description: The self-audience for the operations of the entry service - the aud the entry service accepts on tokens minted for itself.
